info.title: IYA STS Sign-in API
info.description: The sign-in screen's API: what the screen offers for a pending sign-in, and the acts it sends. Unauthenticated and keyed by the pending sign-in's id; every act is bound to the browser's session cookie by a CSRF token. Answers name the next step; refusals are English and carry no error code. And the sign-out page's (#577): what a sign-out would end for the person the session names, and the act that ends it.

The authentication policy, the risk and the issuance policy decide as for any first factor, and a second factor is the next step where one is needed.
